requirements.name: 48 distinct stereo sounds decoded by the native program
Seven downloaded textured and animated mob models
Plains and desert village generation with villagers and golem
Loot chests, transactions, trades and persisted empty chests
Breeding, baby growth, hostile combat and physical mob loot
Source buckets and full-height door collision
GPU projected sun shadows and water/effects depth occlusion
Inventory, input, weapon and reload regressions
Legacy saves preserved unchanged during verification

limits: No long manual session or verification on other graphics cards
Mob movement is simple; instant furnace recipes and no tool durability
